When someone calls from a number you haven\'t saved and says they\'re family, this question shows during the call. The answer shows only while you press and hold it. Never on the lock screen.

Confirm it\'s you to see or change the safe word

Pick a label, such as Family, and set a question only its members can answer. During a call from an unknown number that lasts more than 20 seconds, or after you tap Says they\'re family in More, a discreet card shows the question. Saved members of the label never see it. It stays on this phone.
No labels yet. Make one, such as Family, in Labels.
During a call, Add my helper in More calls one of these people, then lets you merge them into the call so they can hear and help. Never during emergency calls.
You have 3 helpers. Remove one to add another.
